Messages.Author: Michael Patton
Messages.Body:
When two Vampires are "contested", where is the vampire officially on the
playing field. Is he considered in the "controled" area? Obviously he is not 
in torpor or the uncontroled area. Real question is, if one of my vampires
is contested, can I use the Master "Minion Tap" to "move as much blood as you
want from one of the vampires you control to your blood pool" Question came
up tonight and we agreed you could not use Minion Tap in this way. But,
if you still "control" the contested vampire, maybe this is the incorrect
interpretation of this play. Any opinions on this.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Michael Patton <abc@teleport.com> wrote:
>When two Vampires are "contested", where is the vampire officially on the
>playing field. Is he considered in the "controled" area?...

The vampire is effectively out of play.  You cannot do anything with/to
that vampire, including using Minion Tap on it.
